subject: Pay-by-Plate Parking Kiosk Demonstration
overview: An instructional presentation demonstrated how to use Medford's new solar-powered pay-by-plate parking kiosks. The narrator detailed the process for entering a license plate number, paying by coin or card, and retrieving a receipt.

items.title: Demonstration of Pay-by-Plate Parking Kiosks
items.summary: A narrator demonstrated how to activate the kiosk, enter a vehicle license plate number, select parking time, and complete payment using coins or credit and debit cards.
